understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell per directional action when not blocked. Adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed, while walls and boundaries may prevent movement. CLICK switches control to another selectable piece using its pixel/grid coordinates; repeatedly switching pieces alone does not complete a level, and all goals must be occupied simultaneously.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+' at the same time, completing all levels in sequence.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell per directional action when not blocked. Adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed, while walls and boundaries may prevent movement. CLICK switches control to another selectable piece using its pixel/grid coordinates; repeatedly switching pieces alone does not complete a level, and all goals must be occupied simultaneously.
